_comment: Corpus figures that appear as COPY on the first screen, kept as data so tests/test_corpus_facts.py
can assert them against the pinned artifact. A number typed into a paragraph is a number that rots
silently; this project has already retracted one published percentage (the 2026-08-06 77% figure,
which double-counted genres credited to both the US and the UK).
nodes_without_recorded_influences underwrites IMPLEMENTATION 4.5 requirement 5: a refusal must
never become the negative claim 'nobody influenced X'. Most of the corpus has no recorded
influences, so a missing edge is overwhelmingly not evidence of a missing influence.
